name: Fushu
bio: An extremely well-rounded support who grants Skill DMG to allies alongside healing, Sanity restoration, and Skill/ATK Speed buffs. Fights with whipsword and bow, and is one of the few characters able to deliver a large, instant Skill DMG buff with no ramp-up.

skills.name: Subcelestial Solace
skills.desc: Summons 1 [Summon: Yunchi]. A maximum of 2 [Summon: Yunchi] can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Holistic Harmony
skills.desc: Deals Hydro Damage to nearby enemies. Grants Fushu an Ultra Shield and increases her ATK Speed. In addition, Fushu's nearby teammates also receive an Ultra Shield and gain [Nine-Needle Therapy].

skills.name: Archaeus Revival
skills.desc: Using a Combat Sill or Ultimate Skill (either it's Fushu or her nearby teammates) gains 1 stack that increases Skill Speed, up to 10 stacks. The remaining time of the effect is refreshed with each new stack gained.

skills.name: Brimful of Vitality
skills.desc: Increases Skill Damage based on the number of [Summon: Yunchi] on the field.

skills.name: Meridian Synergy
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases Skill DMG for the character and their nearby teammate(s) when 2 or more characters in the team share the same element type.
